content.title: About
content.content: Light mayonnaise is a reduced‑fat dressing, typically containing 5‑10 % fat compared with traditional mayonnaise (≈70 %). It is made from vegetable oils, egg yolk, vinegar or lemon juice, flavorings and stabilizers. The product retains a creamy texture and characteristic taste while providing fewer calories.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Light mayonnaise is widely used in diet‑focused meals and fast‑food restaurants.
To lower calories, part of the oil is replaced with water or low‑fat dairy ingredients.
In some countries light mayonnaise is mandatory in school cafeterias to limit fat intake.
It can be produced with olive, sunflower or rapeseed oil, each giving a distinct flavor profile.

items.title: Low fat content
items.content: Reduced fat helps lower the overall caloric density of meals, supporting weight management.

items.title: Source of vitamin E
items.content: The vegetable oils provide vitamin E, an antioxidant that protects cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Contains omega‑6
items.content: Light mayonnaise supplies linoleic acid, essential for healthy skin and immune function.

items.title: Enhances flavor without excess calories
items.content: Its creamy texture and mild tang allow use in salads, sandwiches and sauces without adding many calories.

items.title: Egg allergy
items.content: Traditional light mayonnaise contains egg yolk, which can trigger allergic reactions.

items.title: Trans‑fat content
items.content: Some industrial versions may contain small amounts of trans fats – these should be limited.

items.title: Sodium
items.content: Salt is added for taste; individuals with hypertension should monitor their intake.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Light mayonnaise is suitable for dressing salads, making sandwiches, sauces, marinades, and as a base for dips. It can be blended with mustard, yogurt or herbs to create varied flavors.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 2‑4 °C in the original container. After opening, consume within 1‑2 weeks. Discard if the smell, color or texture changes.
